name: glassteel
lore_descriptor: a crystal alloy that shines through itself
first_pickup_chronicle: Glassteel. Alloyed in a forge that burned no fuel — the cold flame, the magicians called it. Elements bow to it; mortal damage feels almost incidental.
design_notes: Fills pf 70 gap. Anti-elemental — three resistances. Magical-friendly (max_enchant 5).
